$comment: Tracked permission baseline. Every alphalabs-wt-<id> worktree inherits it.
Before this existed, the only allowlist was the gitignored settings.local.json,
which had accreted to 159 entries — 121 of them with no wildcard at all, each
matching exactly one command that will never be run again, e.g.
Being gitignored, none of it reached the 49 worktrees, so every session
re-prompted from zero while the list grew unbounded in the primary checkout.
These are patterns, not incantations: the read-only inspection and the standard
build/test/lint commands the coding prompt tells every session to run. Anything
that mutates shared state is deliberately absent — `git push`, the pool's write
subcommands, docker, and anything touching IB ports stay prompted.
The tool entries are per-subcommand for exactly that reason. A blanket
--attested-by operator` and `agent_pool.py integrate`, auto-approving the human
attestation path and every shared-state write — the opposite of the line above.
One-off approvals still land in .claude/settings.local.json, which stays
gitignored. If an entry there proves recurring, promote it here.
